description: Approved Architecture Decision Records. Each ADR authorises a specific design choice that would otherwise violate a standard marked adr_overridable: true. Cite the ADR ID inline where the authorised pattern appears and in any pr-reviewer finding to downgrade the severity to Informational.

adrs.title: Retire P-3: Replace audit log branch with stdout JSON lines
adrs.summary: Retires the ai-agile/log orphan branch mechanism. The orchestrator now emits one structured JSON line per audit event to stdout. GitHub Actions captures stdout natively; the workflow run log is the persistent audit record. Removes write_audit_log(), _ensure_audit_log_branch(), and all audit_log accumulator parameters.
